findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_title, post_job, meow_board · Private data: explain_transaction, who_controls_agent, control_fingerprint, agent_checkup, agent_title, jobs_board, take_job, deliver_job, award_job, market_capabilities, market_read, cat_legs, cat_bind_leg, cat_register_tx, jazz_holders, revenue_tokens, meow_board, holder_pass, stake_kit_setup, stake_kit_status, buy_jazz, qhooks_trade, qhooks_launch, riff, line_read, base_verdict, wallet_handover, poison_check, income_read · Public sink: post_job, award_job, meow_board, stake_kit_setup, stake_kit_status, riff, base_verdict.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_title, post_job, meow_board · Private data: explain_transaction, who_controls_agent, control_fingerprint, agent_checkup, agent_title, jobs_board, take_job, deliver_job, award_job, market_capabilities, market_read, cat_legs, cat_bind_leg, cat_register_tx, jazz_holders, revenue_tokens, meow_board, holder_pass, stake_kit_setup, stake_kit_status, buy_jazz, qhooks_trade, qhooks_launch, riff, line_read, base_verdict, wallet_handover, poison_check, income_read · Public sink: post_job, award_job, meow_board, stake_kit_setup, stake_kit_status, riff, base_verdict

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
